title: 1.2.7 Extended Audio Description (Prerecorded) mini-assessment
description: Complete after the required lesson activity.

elements.name: q_1
elements.title: When is extended audio description required?
choices: When foreground-audio pauses are insufficient to convey the sense of the video
elements.correctAnswer: When foreground-audio pauses are insufficient to convey the sense of the video
elements.explanation: The criterion addresses insufficient pauses for necessary descriptions.

elements.name: q_2
elements.title: How does an extended version make time for description?
choices: It pauses the presentation and resumes afterward
elements.correctAnswer: It pauses the presentation and resumes afterward
elements.explanation: Pausing creates space for the description.

elements.name: q_3
elements.title: Why is “diagram changes” potentially insufficient?
choices: It may omit meaningful changes and relationships
elements.correctAnswer: It may omit meaningful changes and relationships
elements.explanation: An adequate description communicates the sense of the visual content.
